provenance.description: The measured resolution of the CPCV path across its own split configurations, on the synthetic positive-control fixture, at one sample size (10,000 bars) x three seeds x both series x seven (n_splits, test_size) configurations. test_size is the fraction of each group used as that group's test set -- not of the sample -- so the effective out-of-sample fraction is test_size / n_splits and the pooled test observations are about test_size * bars regardless of the number of splits. Every number in each row is the framework's own block (summary['test_resolution'] and the Deflated Sharpe / Deflated Alpha blocks it was built from), read by scripts/measure_resolution_vs_sample_size.py; the row also carries the framework's own count of how many of the folds could price the strategy at all (n_folds, folds_with_position). This is a measurement of the decision machinery on a synthetic control -- a formula, not a market -- and never evidence about a security. No threshold, plausibility bound, criterion or verdict is changed by it.

fixture_construction.purpose: TEST-MACHINERY CHECK ON SYNTHETIC DATA: a series produced by a known formula, used to check that the falsifiable-hypothesis machinery can return SUPPORTED. It is not evidence about any security or market.

measured.test_size: the fraction of each group used as that group's test set (effective oos fraction = test_size / n_splits)

provenance.note: The companion sweep of the SAME measurement at 5,000 bars is not committed here; the reference document quotes its numbers and the capture for the 10,000-bar sweep is the pinned one.
